# konnect_identity_group_membership (Resource)

IdentityGroupMembership Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "konnect_identity_group_membership" "my_identitygroupmembership" {
  directory_id = "8a58fdbf-43c1-44f4-a374-04256712d369"
  group_id     = "7f2a67a4-2de2-4271-86de-6be741d5ce51"
  member = {
    id   = "826e1ccc-16d8-4aad-9610-665b8f97b28c"
    type = "principal"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `directory_id` (String) ID of the directory. Requires replacement if changed.
- `group_id` (String) Unique identifier of the group (UUID format). Requires replacement if changed.
- `member` (Attributes) Identifies a single member (principal or group) of a group. Requires replacement if changed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--member))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity creation date.
- `id` (String) Contains a unique identifier used for this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--member"></a>
### Nested Schema for `member`

Required:

- `id` (String) Requires replacement if changed.
- `type` (String) Classifies the kind of member referenced by a group membership entry. possible known values include one of ["principal", "group"]; Requires replacement if changed.

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name of the member. For a principal, its `display_name`; for a group, its `name`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = konnect_identity_group_membership.my_konnect_identity_group_membership
  id = jsonencode({
    directory_id = "..."
    group_id     = "..."
    id           = "..."
  })
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import konnect_identity_group_membership.my_konnect_identity_group_membership '{"directory_id": "...", "group_id": "...", "id": "..."}'
```
